page.overview:
What is Chalcedony?

Chalcedony was a location, probably a planet, given to Count Odusseus Atreides in 1099 AG after House Corrino was restored to the Imperial throne, soon after the coronation of Josif I. Achilleus Atreides used the money from Chalcedony family estates in order to invest in CHOAM shares of undeveloped worlds.
